title: Double Jeopardy and Climate Impact in the Use of Large Language Models: Socio-economic Disparities and Reduced Utility for Non-English Speakers

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the tokenization premium (fragmentation rate) of non-English languages compared to English, and evaluating model performance using back-translation tasks for low-resource languages.
Correlating tokenization costs and LLM translation performance with the population-weighted GDP per capita and World Bank income level classifications of the countries where the languages are spoken.
